newsitem.title: USA: BIG Entertainment Dec same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: BIG Entertainment Dec same-store sales up.

text.p: BIG Entertainment Inc said Tuesday the preliminary results from its entertainment super-kiosk retail division show same-store sales increased 27.5 percent in December from a year earlier.
Same-store sales for the fourth quarter of 1996 increased 24.4 percent from a year ago, it said.
Retail sales for all stores for the fourth quarter increased 143 percent from the 1995 fourth quarter, BIG said.
It made no dollar amounts available.
